findings.failed_endpoint: All four fail identically with 401 when the browser has no session cookie. The error message names none of them.
findings.advertiser_numbering: The Advertisers surface renders the rules store (ADV_01..ADV_45). Names come from displayNameOf() which falls back to prettifyRawId(). SEED_ID_PATTERN matches ADV_## and returns the raw id unchanged. So the surface shows 'ADV_01' through 'ADV_45'. The names file (advertiser_names.csv, 41 Hebrew names) is only read by the /api/advertisers/identity endpoint, not by /api/advertisers. The Advertisers tab calls /api/advertisers, not /api/advertisers/identity.
findings.campaigns_store: data/campaigns.csv has the header only. The store is fully wired: COLUMNS, CRUD, lock, backup, versioning. Zero campaigns booked.
findings.rollup_table: The 'campaigns seen in source data' table is the legacy _build_campaigns() rollup. It reads the Campaign column from data/Spots.csv (or reference/Spots.xlsx). It is a catalog-level diagnostic: which campaign strings the uploaded spots file actually carries. It is not a booked campaign list.
